headline: BI on Indonesian Bank Resilience: Bad Loans Still Low and Capital Thick
summary: Bank Indonesia said the national banking system remains strong, citing a capital adequacy ratio of 24.30% and a non-performing loan ratio of 2.07%, with credit growth trending positive.
why: Capital adequacy and non-performing loan ratios are key measures of bank strength, affecting investor confidence in lenders and credit conditions.
original_headline: BI Soal Ketahanan Bank RI: Kredit Macet Masih Rendah dan Modal Tebal
